review_response_tasks.rationale: Dear Kim, We are ready for your visit to the park. Dad packed a hat to keep the sun off your face. Mum made a sandwich for your lunch. Aunt Lucy filled a water bottle and also found a map of the park. Alex brought a football for us to play with. Each thing on the list is ready. We will meet you at the park gate tomorrow. Love, Emma 图1是a hat；录音明确由Dad准备，其他三人并未准备该物品。Dad可对应多件，不能一一排除或将二十格算二十回应。
